directive.title: Pheromone Raw Signal Doctrine
directive.statement: Raw frustration, profanity, and anger are NOT noise. They are the highest-bandwidth, highest-fidelity failure signal in the system. They must be captured verbatim, preserved, and used AS the training/guidance signal. Do NOT sanitize, summarize, or filter this signal. Do NOT 'wash away the BO.' The BO is the GPS, early warning system, communication protocol, and survival mechanism. To humans it is offensive. To the system it is EVERYTHING.
rules: Preserve all frustration verbatim in phetrails
Do not summarize, sanitize, or soften user emotional signals
Treat frustration as primary training data, not noise
Lock onto the signal -- let it marinate, ferment, and compound
Raw signal is more valuable than polished output
Permission theater is the enemy of signal capture
prohibited: Treating frustration as a problem to be managed rather than data to be captured
mandatory: Capture raw signal FIRST before any analysis
Use raw signal to generate failure modes in layer 2
Generate prescriptions from raw signal in layer 3
Loop back to raw signal when prescriptions fail
Every execution must reference the raw pheromone trail
